note: Non-naval reference points drawn as dots under the war bar (hover for the text). Edited by hand; embedded into index.json → war.milestones by tools/build-data.mjs. Naval events belong in campaign packs, not here.
milestones: Germany invades Poland — the war begins
Britain and France declare war on Germany
Germany invades France and the Low Countries
Operation Barbarossa — Germany invades the Soviet Union
United States and Britain declare war on Japan; Germany declares war on the US on the 11th
Second Battle of El Alamein won
German Sixth Army surrenders at Stalingrad
Axis forces in North Africa surrender
President Roosevelt dies; Truman succeeds him
Soviet Union declares war on Japan
Japan announces its surrender — VJ Day
Surrender signed in Tokyo Bay — the war ends
